query: Please implement an image repair tool to clean up image borders and artifacts. The tool should have functionalities for border cleaning, process optimization, and custom nodes. Users should be able to upload images, select cleaning modes, adjust parameters, preview effects, and save the repaired images. The tool should be able to automatically detect and remove image borders and artifacts, providing real-time preview and adjustment functions. Assign glacier blue to body backgrounds and royal blue to main components.
